info.description: Self-hosted subscription manager. Every operation is also available to AI agents over MCP at /mcp.
info.title: Exhale API

get.description: Charges whose date passed without confirmation, and payment methods about to expire.

post.description: Adds a category for grouping subscriptions.

get.description: Recent changes with who made them (member, agent or system). Each id can be passed to undo.

post.description: Reverts a change by its auditId, restoring the previous state.

get.description: Charges due between two dates (default: the next 30 days), with ids, amounts, status and whether they were moved.

post.description: Changes the amount of a charge. scope=following (default) also changes the subscription price for later charges; scope=this only this charge.
Moves a charge to another date. scope=this (default) for a one-off delay; scope=following to change the billing day from this charge on.
Resolves a charge: paid (optionally with the amount the bank actually took, in any currency), failed, skipped, or pending to reopen it.
post.summary: Mark a charge paid, failed or skipped

get.description: Start here. Returns a live Markdown briefing: today's date and time zone, members, every subscription with ids, the next 30 days of charges, what needs attention, and the rules for changing anything safely.
Household settings, members, categories and payment methods with their ids.

post.description: Creates a payment method (no id) or updates one (with id): name, kind, last four digits, expiry date and owner.
post.summary: Create or update a payment method

post.description: Computes the charge dates of a billing rule with Exhale's engine (month-end and leap-day aware) without saving anything.

get.description: Lists subscriptions with price, cadence, next charge, monthly cost, category and payment method. Filter by status or name.

post.description: Adds a recurring subscription and computes its upcoming charges. Use dryRun to preview the charge dates first.
Permanently deletes a subscription and its charges. Prefer set_subscription_status to cancel. Can be reverted with undo.
Pauses, resumes or cancels a subscription. cancel_at_period_end keeps the service until the day before the next charge; cancel_now stops future charges immediately.
Changes name, price (from the next open charge on), category, payment method, payer, privacy, URL, notes, auto-confirm or reminder settings. Only the fields you pass change.

get.description: One subscription with its upcoming charges (with charge ids) and its charge history.
Monthly and yearly recurring spend per currency, spend per category, and the charges of the next 7 days.
